description: This header file 'ipAddrUtils.h' provides declarations for utility functions related to IP address handling, including retrieving interface IP addresses, hostname resolution, and IP address validation.

methods.name: getInterfaceIpAddressV4
methods.description: Returns the local IPv4 address of a specified network interface; caller must free the returned string if not NULL.

methods.name: isHostnameResolvable
methods.description: Checks if the provided hostname can be resolved.

methods.name: resolveHostname
methods.description: Resolves the IP address of the given hostname; caller must free the returned string.

methods.name: isValidIpAddress
methods.description: Validates whether the given string is a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.
